style: Consistent game art set: deep navy night sky, brass-coloured observatory equipment, soft flat shading with gentle highlights, clean shapes, 2D game asset. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, symbols or logos anywhere. Do not depict any real nebula, star cluster or galaxy.

assets.prompt: A wide empty night-sky observatory background: deep navy sky with scattered small stars and a faint soft band of haze, a subtle star-chart grid of thin faint lines, dark observatory dome silhouette at the bottom edge. Calm, low contrast so game cards on top stay readable.

Front view of a telescope eyepiece surround: a thick brass ring with dark metal outer plate filling the whole square image to its corners, with one perfectly centred circular opening whose diameter is only 60 percent of the image width, so a wide brass ring and a wide dark navy plate margin surround it (the whole brass ring spans about 75 percent of the width). The opening is fully transparent. Brass rim, small screws, dark navy metal plate.

A portrait 2:3 collectible card frame, brass border and dark navy body, with a large empty rectangular photo window in the upper two thirds (transparent) and a plain empty dark navy band below for text. Nothing inside the band. Rounded corners.

A portrait 2:3 collectible card back, same brass border and rounded corners as a card frame, dark navy centre filled with a simple abstract mysterious pattern of concentric brass rings and tiny stars, an empty unknown feel. No question mark, no text.
A friendly headquarters agent character, upper body, young researcher in a navy jacket with brass buttons and a headset, welcoming pose, transparent background.

A wide landscape empty tray panel seen from the front: brass rim around a plain dark navy empty interior where cards can be dropped. Flat, simple, nothing inside. Transparent background outside the tray.
A single bold game icon: a brass magnifying glass with a plus-shaped lens mark drawn as geometry only, centred, thick simple shapes readable at 88 pixels, transparent background.
A single bold game icon: a brass telescope focus knob dial with a circular crosshair-like target ring, centred, thick simple shapes readable at 88 pixels, transparent background.
A single bold game icon: a glowing brass lightbulb with a warm soft glow, centred, thick simple shapes readable at 88 pixels, transparent background.
A simple round rank badge for a beginner researcher: plain bronze disc with one small star in the centre, modest and plain, transparent background.
A round rank badge for a regular researcher: brass disc with a laurel ring and two stars, more ornate than a plain bronze badge, transparent background.

A grand round rank badge for a senior researcher: gold and brass disc with an ornate laurel wreath, three stars, a small crown-like crest on top, gems and a glow, the most impressive of three badges, transparent background.

A single wide horizontal game UI button plate seen straight on, exactly three times wider than it is tall, centred and spanning most of the image width: a flat dark navy face with an even brass rim of constant thickness all around and softly rounded corners. The face is completely plain and empty (no text, no icon, no gems, no ornament in the middle) so it can be stretched. Transparent background outside the plate.

A single round game UI button plate seen straight on, centred: a flat dark navy circular face with an even brass rim, plain and empty in the middle (no text, no icon, no symbol) so an icon can sit on top. Transparent background outside the circle.

A single rectangular game UI text panel seen straight on, centred and spanning most of the image: a flat dark navy face with a thin even brass border line of constant thickness all around and softly rounded corners. The face is completely plain and empty (no text, no pattern, no ornament) so it can be stretched as a text box. Transparent background outside the panel.

A single bold game icon: a brass camera shutter button, a round brass ring with a smaller raised round button in the middle and a few simple aperture-blade shapes, centred, thick simple shapes readable at 88 pixels, transparent background.

A single bold game icon: one solid five-pointed star in warm gold and brass with a soft highlight, perfectly upright and centred, filling most of the image, thick simple shape readable at 40 pixels, transparent background.
Derived by gen-art.mjs from icon-star.png: same alpha shape, dark navy fill with a dim brass outline.
A single bold game icon: a simple warm sun, a round orange-gold disc with short thick triangular rays around it, centred, thick simple shapes readable at 40 pixels, transparent background.
A single bold game icon: a simple crescent moon in pale silver-cream with a soft highlight, centred, thick simple shape readable at 40 pixels, transparent background.

A single bold round game button: a brass ring around a dark navy round face with one large warm gold eighth-note musical note in the middle, the note drawn as simple geometry, centred, thick simple shapes readable at 44 pixels, transparent background outside the round button.

A single bold round game button for music switched off: a dim dull brass ring around a dark navy round face with one large grey eighth-note musical note in the middle and one thick diagonal brass bar crossing over the note from upper left to lower right, centred, thick simple shapes readable at 44 pixels, muted colours, transparent background outside the round button.

assets.style: Children's picture-book illustration in soft gouache and watercolour, fairy-tale mood, deep navy night sky with brass and warm gold accents, gentle glow, rich but calm colours. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, symbols or logos anywhere. Do not copy any real photograph.
assets.prompt: Wide landscape scene. On a small grassy hilltop at the lower right stands a tiny domed observatory with a brass telescope pointing up. Beside it a child astronomer in a navy coat and scarf holds a large open collector's album that glows softly. From the vast starry sky, small luminous cloud-like wisps in rose, teal and amber and little bunches of tiny twinkling stars drift gently down toward the open album like fireflies. A soft band of the Milky Way arcs across the sky. A warm lantern glows at the child's feet. The upper left two thirds of the picture is calm, darker open night sky with only small stars, left empty for a title.
